core_categories: Pharmaceutical Distribution; OTC and Consumer Products; Medical Supplies; Retail Pharmacy Networks; Biopharma Services; Private Label Brands
specialty_focus: McKesson Canada is a diversified healthcare distributor and services company, the largest pharmaceutical distributor in Canada. It distributes brand and generic pharmaceuticals, OTC products, and medical supplies to pharmacies and healthcare providers, and operates retail pharmacy banners. It also provides specialized biopharma services including third-party logistics, market access consulting, and patient support programs for complex medications. While it distributes medical supplies, it does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
key_brands: Guardian, I.D.A., Remedy'sRx, Proxim, Uniprix, Option+, savvy, Nosh & Co., Kit, Be Better, Rose & Robin, naturemary, others
